fem.text: The Order of the Ebon Hand, a religious order devoted to Tourach, gets its thrulls when Endrek Sahr creates the first of them on Sarpadia as slaves, introducing alchemic elements into the Order's necromancy.
The thrulls, bred for sacrifice, breed at a terrifying pace, and Reod Dai convinces them to turn on their masters, so they annihilate the Order.
The Ebon Hand is torn apart by the Thrull Rebellion, and the thrulls overrun the whole of Sarpadia, leaving only thrulls and thallids.
